verdict.rationale: LegalOS is a web-based immigration-filing SaaS, so opting out of telemetry, analytics or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry controls, cookie or analytics opt-outs, or a privacy policy covering usage tracking. The pack covers only visa and green-card workflows, attorney review, fees, and failed probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI.
